example: Ich habe vergessen die Klobrille runterzuklappen.
example_gloss: I forgot to put the toilet seat down.
etymology: Klo (toilet) + Brille (glasses) - looks like glasses for your toilet
mnemonic: Germans joke about the Klobrille being the most important seat in the house

example: Die Rentner wurden auf eine Kaffeefahrt eingeladen.
example_gloss: The retirees were invited on a coffee excursion.
mnemonic: A trip where they give you coffee then sell you overpriced goods

example: Er ist ein echter Erbsenzaehler der immer alles genau zaehlt.
example_gloss: He is a real bean counter who always counts everything precisely.
mnemonic: Someone so pedantic they count individual peas

example: So ein Warmduscher nimmt nie kalte Duschen.
example_gloss: Such a wimp never takes cold showers.
mnemonic: A person too wimpy to take cold showers
Short for Schatz meaning treasure - your little treasure
